scripts.db:create: npm run db:create:production & npm run db:create:dev
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:reset:production & npm run db:reset:dev
scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:migrate:production & npm run db:migrate:dev
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:create & npm run db:migrate
scripts.db:seed:production: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npx sequelize-cli db:seed:all --env production
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:seed:production & npm run db:seed:dev
scripts.db:seed:undo: npm run db:seed:undo:production & npm run db:seed:undo:dev
scripts.db:remake: npm run db:reset & npm run db:setup
scripts.db:reload: npm run db:remake & npm run db:seed
scripts.db:reseed: npm run db:seed:undo & npm run db:seed
scripts.db:dev: npm run db:reset:dev & npm run db:create:dev & npm run db:migrate:dev
